init.title: InfoMentor Options
init.description:
Pick the phones (notify services) that should get InfoMentor notifications — a replacement for the InfoMentor app's broken push notifications. Use the "Send test notification" button on the device to check it works. Only change username/password if needed; leave the password empty to keep the current one.

For a school lunch sensor, paste your school's menu link from Mateo (the meny.mateo.se page, ending in a number such as …/kommun/123) or just that number. Leave it empty to turn it off.
